clock_targets.design_point_justification: N01 section 7 named 24.576 MHz the design point with 12.288 MHz viable only if the shared core sustains <= 2 clk/eval all-in; H01 measured 1 clk/eval kernel-only, leaving 1.67 clk/eval at 12.288 MHz for storage+control+output, which the line-by-line worst-case budget below refutes
clock_targets.timing_closure_note: no timing claim exists: ss-corner closure at 24.576 MHz is unproven (D01 section 2; sibling implies 14.0 MHz ss minimum on a different design) and is H10's measurement

budget_worst_case.policy: worst_case_never_average: every consumer is accounted at its worst admissible per-frame value; the frame must close for every admissible frame; a schedule that closes only when event bursts or envelope transitions are rare is the forbidden average-case argument (issue #25 negative control)

rows.consumer: operator evaluations (mkiSin + phase advance + per-eval convert pipeline)
rows.unit_basis: H01 probe measured sustained throughput 1 clk/eval (3-stage pipeline, 4,794/4,794 bit-exact); evidence/h01-operator-probe
rows.count_basis: 16 notes x 6 ops x 64 samples (structural worst case: every voice live every frame; NUM-002)

rows.consumer: operator-envelope steps, worst case including a segment advance (levellut target, qrate, statics hold, inc_ x sr_multiplier constant multiply; env.cc:63-151)
rows.unit_basis: N01 section 7 budgeted 8-12 clk for the step alone; the worst-case step additionally executes advance() (scaleoutlevel/levellut + qrate + statics + the 15,414,067 constant multiply); 24 clk is the upper-bound estimate H04 must measure
rows.count_basis: one step per operator per frame (N03 cadence fact, env.h:39-40; NUM-005)

rows.consumer: per-operator frequency updates: Freqlut 1025-entry interpolated lookup (freqlut.cc:27-42)
rows.unit_basis: index compute + two table reads + interpolate; N01 section 7 counted 96 lookups/frame in the ~1,300-1,600 control estimate
rows.count_basis: 6 ops x 16 notes; per-op basepitch differs (coarse/fine/detune), pitch EG + LFO enter before the LUT (dx7note.cc:279-281; NUM-003)

rows.unit_basis: N01 section 7 grouped 17 LFO/pitch-env steps in the control estimate; upper bound per step

rows.consumer: LFO: one getsample + one getdelay per frame, all six waveforms (lfo.cc)
rows.unit_basis: N01 NUM-007 cost estimate ~50-100 clk/frame; worst case taken
rows.count_basis: shared per timbre, once per frame (NUM-007)

rows.consumer: pitch-mod application into each note's logfreq (log-domain add of LFO x depth; dx7note.cc:210-217)
rows.unit_basis: one shift-add chain per note per frame
per-op gain modification once per frame
rows.count_basis: all operators of all notes, worst case (NUM-008; N08 ampmod-ams3 renders this path byte-exact)

rows.consumer: control-tail state writes: 96 envelope commits + 16 pitch-EG commits
rows.unit_basis: one register-file write per clock (H02 port structure)

rows.consumer: note-on application: steal scan + per-op derived params (scaleoutlevel, ScaleLevel, ScaleVelocity, ScaleRate; dx7note.cc:163-179) + basepitch + phase/gain init
rows.unit_basis: 16-clk steal scan + 6 ops x ~14 clk derivation + 6 x 8 clk basepitch + 12 clk init, rounded up to 224; host-side float math is off-frame per NUM-008 (DEC-010 boundary)
rows.count_basis: worst admissible burst: a 16-note chord change in one frame (polyphony bound, DEC-003)

rows.consumer: note-off application: voice lookup + keydown/sustain branch (DEC-018) + reclaim predicate check (NUM-012)
rows.count_basis: worst admissible burst: full chord release in one frame

rows.consumer: controller event application (sustain, pitch-bend scale commit, mod wheel, volume): store + mark pitch-dirty across notes
rows.unit_basis: chip receives frozen integer scale factors (float-gated math stays host-side, NUM-008); per-note dirty marking
rows.count_basis: one controller per voice in the worst admissible frame alongside the chord change

rows.consumer: atomic patch-commit bookkeeping at the frame boundary (generation swap + per-note tag ring)
rows.unit_basis: shadow image swap is 1 clk; the budget carries ring bookkeeping + a held-note tag sweep
rows.count_basis: at most one commit per frame (events commit at the boundary; DEC-019)

rows.consumer: per-note output conversion (>>>4, clip +/-2^24 with the +32768 quirk, >>>9) + unclamped >=20-bit mix add (NUM-010)
rows.unit_basis: H01 stage 3 measured convert+clip inside 1 clk; +1 clk for the 20-bit mix add; NUM-010 budgeted 2-4 clk, pipelined, serialized here (no free overlap assumed)
rows.count_basis: 16 notes x 64 samples, all live (structural worst case)

rows.consumer: I2S sample loads into the transmitter (BCLK/LRCLK are frame-counter bits; shifting is a dedicated divider, zero core-clock serialization)
rows.unit_basis: one registered load per sample (parasynth synth_top 'I2S load@255' pattern)

rows.consumer: SPI write-queue drain into the shadow image (1 write/clk, oldest first)
rows.unit_basis: one shadow-image write per clock; count = worst admissible writes/frame at SCK = f_core/4 with a 48-bit frame + 2-cycle CS gap = 194 core clk per transaction

rows.consumer: frame controller tick + op-core pipeline fill (3-stage latency, once per frame)

totals.headline: 12.288 MHz DOES NOT close the worst case: 17,260 clocks demanded against 16,384 available (105.35%, shortfall 876 clocks). The forbidden average-case framing would 'close' it only by dropping the worst-burst event rows (an idle frame is 12,332 clocks = 75.3%): that is exactly the average-case argument issue #25 rejects. 24.576 MHz closes with 15,424 clocks of margin (52.93% worst-case utilization) and is the design point.
totals.family_calibration: parasynth monosynth ~154/256 clk/frame (~60%, average-case measured; its worst-case bursts are why average arguments fail), ladder filter 24 cycles/channel x 8 = 192/256 (75%, practical ceiling datapoint); quoted as family calibration, never transferred as a budget (D01 section 2)

storage_ports.structure: flop banks per H02 verdict: 96 op banks x 325 b + 16 note banks x 446 b = 38,336 replicated runtime bits; patch-shared store per DEC-019 below
storage_ports.ports_per_eval_slot: 2R (op bank + owning note bank, parallel) + 1W (staged writeback)
storage_ports.staged_writeback: a slot's new op-bank value rides a stage register and writes the single W port at a later slot of the same bank (96-slot interleaving); note-bank writes (feedback history + accumulator, 2x32 b per note-sample) use the same W port in disjoint slots
conflict_resolutions: same-slot read-modify-write (feedback history) is impossible on one W port: resolved by the staged delayed writeback (H02 section 4 conflict 1)
1RW SRAM macros cannot serve 2R+1W per eval cycle: resolved by the flop verdict (H02 section 4 conflict 2, section 5)
eval-read vs env-write: control-tail writes occupy slots after the eval pass (slot-disjoint windows); frame-boundary commit writes occupy the tick cycle (slot 0), never an eval slot
same-cycle dual write never occurs: write traffic is bounded below the port supply (see write_traffic_bound)

write_traffic_bound.verdict: feasible at both clocks with the single W port; H02 section 4 numbers, event writes added by this contract

storage_ports.measured_anchor: H02 mapped 38,781 flops = 38,336 replicated + 444 patch + 1 obs, 4.115 mm2 all-in on the probe structure; bounded finding: the 16-note state cannot be all-register in a quarter slot (owner architecture decision pending, H02 section 6) - this contract assumes the flop organization and does not resolve the area finding

patch_interface.commit_policy: atomic at a 64-sample frame boundary (DEC-019); a patch selection commits before frame N+1; held notes keep the patch they started with until note-off + release completion (DEC-019, DEC-021)
patch_interface.mechanism: patch bytes arrive as SPI register writes into a shadow image (continuously drained, never live); the frame-boundary commit swaps the shadow into a 4-entry committed-patch ring; each note binds the generation it started on (2-bit tag)
patch_interface.held_note_bound: a held note keeps its exact starting patch for up to 3 subsequent commits (4-entry ring); a 4th commit while a note is still held evicts its generation and is a declared DEC-019 conformance gap - owner ruling required for unbounded held-note patch binding (alternative: per-note replication of rates/levels, +5,376 bits)
patch_interface.load_cost: a 161-byte voice + performance settings arrive as <= 216 writes, absorbed by the drain at <= 168 writes/frame (2 frames worst case), never blocking the audio schedule

event_interface.transport: SPI slave, mode 0, 48-bit frames {F, 6'b0, SEC, A[7:0], D[31:0]} adapted from gf180-parasynth DR-0007 rtl-sketch/spi_ctl.v (Apache-2.0, provenance recorded); SEC pages: 0 = events/performance, 1 = patch bytes
event_interface.sck_limit: SCK <= f_core/4 (two-flop synchronizer sampling); 6.144 MHz at the 24.576 MHz design point, 3.072 MHz at 12.288 MHz
event_interface.queue: bounded skid FIFO, depth 8 entries x 49 bits (48-bit frame + valid), continuously drained into the shadow image at 1 write/clk
event_interface.queue_depth_derivation: worst admissible arrival = 1 write per 194 core clocks (SCK = f_core/4, 48-bit frame + 2-cycle CS gap); drain = 1 write/clk = 194x the arrival rate, so 8-deep absorption is provably sufficient and overflow is impossible at the declared SCK bound
event_interface.overflow_policy: explicit rejection per DEC-014: the overflow flag is sticky, reported in the status word, cleared on read; a dropped write is a contract defect (the host retries); silent drops and silent deferral are forbidden (DEC-014)
event_interface.commit_boundary: an event received during frame N is applied before the first sample of frame N+1 (DEC-014 + NUM-011; identical to the pinned oracle's event_to_block_policy)
event_interface.worst_burst: 16 note-ons + 16 note-offs + 16 controller events in one frame (48 writes <= 84 admissible at 12.288 MHz, <= 168 at 24.576 MHz); budgeted in budget_worst_case rows note_on_application/note_off_application/controller_events
event_interface.never_silent: every accepted event appears in the block-level event-application trace (N08 manifest traces); a stolen/rejected event is surfaced in status/trace metadata (DEC-017)

status_word.pattern_source: gf180-parasynth DR-0007 section 4 + rtl-sketch/spi_ctl.v status word {0x4D, VERSION, overrun, queue_nonempty, overflow, fresh, frame[15:0]} (Apache-2.0, adapted; ARCHITECTURE section 9 first-read 0x4D210001)
status_word.word: {MAGIC 8'hD7, VERSION 4'h1, OVERRUN, QUEUE, OVERFLOW, FRESH, FRAME[15:0]}

flags.OVERRUN: schedule deadline missed (control pass or eval pass unfinished at its window end) - sticky defect detector, must never set; set at the tick like the parasynth overrun flag
flags.OVERFLOW: a write was dropped (impossible at the declared SCK bound; sticky defect detector per DEC-014 backpressure)
flags.FRESH: no write accepted since reset; host boots on fresh=1 and re-sends the image whenever fresh reads 1 later (brown-out, parasynth ARCHITECTURE section 7 protocol)
flags.FRAME: 16-bit frame counter (750 frames/s at 48 kHz); the I2S LRCLK/BCLK derive from it as counter bits

status_word.transpose_note: the core applies only the patch's own transpose/scaling/velocity parameters exactly once (DEC-023); host MIDI transposition is host-side; N08 perf-transpose-12 pins the observed wrapper behavior as the conformance reference

reset_boot.pad_reset: RST_N through a two-flop synchronizer; every block uses synchronous reset; frame counter and link reset by the pad only (parasynth ARCHITECTURE section 7 pattern)
reset_boot.soft_reset: a SOFT_RESET register write clears voice/env/phase state and the event shadow; it never touches the link, the queue, or the frame counter (per-page soft-reset pattern)
reset_boot.boot_protocol: reset -> fresh=1 in the status word -> host sends patch image + performance settings -> atomic commit at a frame boundary -> engine runs; DEC-011 requires the post-reset state (LFO/phase init) to be explicit and render-repeatability tested

latency.definition: event-sample -> I2S-out latency is measured from the sample position p of an event's arrival (frame N) to the SDATA bit of the first audio sample its commit affects
latency.commit_rule: first affected sample is frame N+1 sample 0 (DEC-014/NUM-011)
latency.worst_case_to_sdata_note: <= (64 - p) samples until the boundary + <= 64 samples serialization position + 1, declared as <= 2 frames = 128 samples = 2.667 ms
latency.measurable_for: H07/H09 acceptance: the measured (first_affected_sdata_slot - event_sample) must land in [(64-p), (64-p)+65] samples; comparisons align events per NUM-011

trace_access.state_observability: H02-style load-bearing observability: every state bank drives a read mux; per-module state_obs XOR folds keep synthesis honest; dropping any field drops mapped flops and fails the gate (H01/H02 negative-control pattern)
trace_access.block_taps: optional per-frame tap bus (frame counter, live_mask, keydown_mask, lfo_value, applied-event log) mirroring the R05 trace registry columns; taps are read-only and must be non-invasive (traced and untraced renders byte-identical, TRACE-PLAN rule)
trace_access.conformance_use: event-application traces are part of the N08 bundle (138 applied events); RTL traces must match the frozen traces after declared latency alignment

modules.name: frame_controller
modules.role: cycle counter, tick/go, window enforcement (commit, control tail, eval pass, mix, I2S), OVERRUN flag
modules.clock: single core clock; no derived clocks (BCLK/LRCLK are counter bits)
modules.handshake: tick/go pulses to all blocks; busy collection at the tick
modules.conformance_oracle: n08_verify_release sha256-exact suite + OVERRUN-never-sets across all 51 vectors + directed late-finish injection control

modules.name: op_core
modules.role: shared 6-op x 16-note evaluation kernel (mkiSin + phase advance + convert pipeline)
modules.handshake: en/busy/out_valid in acceptance order (H01 pattern); ld_phase for directed corners
modules.conformance_oracle: H01 4,794-vector bit-exact equivalence retained + N08 vectors sha256-exact; MUTATE_ADDRWIDTH control kept live

modules.name: state_banks
modules.role: 96 op banks x 325 b + 16 note banks x 446 b, 2R+1W staged-writeback port structure
modules.reset: synchronous; all state defined at reset (DEC-011)
modules.handshake: combinational bank reads per eval slot; staged writeback acknowledge
modules.conformance_oracle: H02 readback smoke + full-flop-count gate + strip-observability control + N08 vectors

modules.name: env_unit
modules.reset: synchronous; envelopes parked at the DEC-021/N01 floor state
modules.conformance_oracle: N08 vectors sha256-exact; sr_multiplier +-1 control retained from N03

modules.name: pitch_mod_unit
modules.role: Freqlut lookups, LFO, pitch-mod/amp-mod application, transpose/scaling once (DEC-023)
modules.reset: synchronous; LFO phase per DEC-020/DEC-011 declared init
modules.handshake: params_valid from state banks; freq/gain outputs committed before go
modules.conformance_oracle: N08 vectors sha256-exact (event alignment per NUM-011)

modules.name: algorithm_router
modules.role: 32-algorithm routing + Mark I gate (threshold 16284) + feedback (algorithms 4/6 serial, +2 shift)
modules.clock: core clock (wiring + compares; no per-eval clock cost beyond op_evals)
modules.handshake: per-eval in/out with the op pipeline
modules.conformance_oracle: N08 vectors sha256-exact; broken_feedback mutation control retained (N08 mutation battery)

modules.name: mixer
modules.role: per-note convert + unclamped >=20-bit mix (NUM-010 exact-sum proof)
modules.handshake: note accumulator in, frame mix out to i2s_tx
modules.conformance_oracle: N08 ev-sum-15 (the only preregistered case summing past per-note rails) sha256-exact; voice_sum_order_swap mutation control retained

modules.name: spi_ctl
modules.role: SPI slave link: 48-bit frames, skid queue, continuous shadow drain, status word on MISO
modules.clock: core clock; SCK/MOSI/CS_N through two-flop synchronizers (SCK <= f_core/4)
modules.reset: pad only (soft reset never touches the link)
modules.handshake: wr_valid/wr_addr/wr_data write port; MISO status word at CS_N fall
modules.conformance_oracle: pin-to-acceptance + drain-order bench (parasynth verify_ctl pattern, adapted) + every N08 event trace reproduced in order

modules.name: i2s_tx
modules.role: I2S transmitter: BCLK/LRCLK from frame-counter bits, one load per sample
modules.handshake: sample load handshake with the mixer/frame controller
modules.conformance_oracle: decoded-wire vs model bench (sibling tb_synth_top pattern, adapted) + H07/H09 latency measurement per the latency definition

stale_rules.contract_change: any change to docs/CONTRACT-CORE-v1.md or spec/core-contract-v1.json after H04-H07 implementation starts requires a new decision record and marks the affected modules' RTL evidence STALE (status vocabulary per AGENTS.md)
stale_rules.artifact_drift: drift of any hash in depends_on (N08 bundle, numeric profile, H01/H02 evidence) fails tools/h03_budget_check.py and marks every H03-derived budget STALE until re-derived from the new artifacts
stale_rules.clock_change: changing the design point or the fallback verdict requires a new DR (owner sign-off item); polyphony (DEC-003) and reference budgets are never relaxation knobs
stale_rules.negative_control: a budget that closes only by removing or shrinking worst-burst rows fails the checker (required_row_ids + recorded verdicts are enforced)
